收到你的要求。我还没完全理解细节，所以先不执行任何命令。先确认几件事：

- drow_ranger_pierce：你期望“穿透后”弹道继续按原方向飞行，是指同一投射物穿透目标后继续飞？还是创建新的投射物？现在“朝上停在原地”是指 Z 轴抬升然后速度为 0 吗？
- drow_ranger_explode：你说要用 Sticky Bomb 爆炸特效，能否确认是哪个英雄/技能的特效资源？（例如 `snapfire_sticky_bomb_explosion` 之类的粒子名）如果你已有特效路径请直接给。
- drow_ranger_ranged_attack_explode_2：没有提升伤害，是指物品/天赋描述有加成但实际伤害不变？请确认是哪一段数据（`shop1_items_enhance.txt` 还是 `shop1_items.txt`）应该生效，以及期望的加成数值。
- drow_ranger_knife：需求是“首次命中目标后，以目标为起点搜索周围敌人，如有敌人就施放 Bounty Hunter Shuriken Toss”。请确认搜索范围、目标数量（只对一个还是链式？）、以及是否要从首次命中目标对周围敌人发射，还是对周围敌人从施法者发射？

你确认后我再开始分析和改代码/加 log。

local enhance_common = require("abilities.enhance.enhance_common")

LinkLuaModifier("modifier_drow_ranger_pierce",
    "abilities/enhance/drow_ranger_pierce.lua", LUA_MODIFIER_MOTION_NONE)

drow_ranger_pierce = class({})

function drow_ranger_pierce:GetIntrinsicModifierName()
    return "modifier_drow_ranger_pierce"
end

function drow_ranger_pierce:OnProjectileHit_ExtraData(target, pos, data)
    if not IsServer() then return end
    if not target or target:IsNull() then
        return false
    end
    if not data then
        return false
    end
    if data.hit_count and data.max_hits and data.hit_count >= data.max_hits then
        return true
    end

    local owner = data.owner_entindex and EntIndexToHScript(data.owner_entindex) or nil
    if not owner or owner:IsNull() then
        return true
    end

    enhance_common.ApplyProjectileDamage(owner, target, {
        base_damage = data.base_damage or 0,
        damage_scale = data.damage_scale or 1,
        pure_percent = data.pure_percent or 0,
        ability = self,
    })

    data.hit_count = (data.hit_count or 0) + 1
    if data.max_hits and data.hit_count >= data.max_hits then
        return true
    end

    return false
end

modifier_drow_ranger_pierce = class({})

function modifier_drow_ranger_pierce:IsHidden() return true end
function modifier_drow_ranger_pierce:IsPurgable() return false end
function modifier_drow_ranger_pierce:RemoveOnDeath() return false end

function modifier_drow_ranger_pierce:DeclareFunctions()
    return {
        MODIFIER_EVENT_ON_ATTACK_LANDED,
    }
end

function modifier_drow_ranger_pierce:OnCreated()
    if not IsServer() then return end
    local ability = self:GetAbility()
    if not ability then
        return
    end
    self.pierce_count = math.max(tonumber(ability:GetSpecialValueFor("pierce_count") or 0) or 0, 0)
    self.max_distance = math.max(tonumber(ability:GetSpecialValueFor("pierce_max_distance") or 0) or 0, 0)
    self.projectile_speed = tonumber(ability:GetSpecialValueFor("pierce_projectile_speed") or 0) or 0
    self.projectile_radius = tonumber(ability:GetSpecialValueFor("pierce_projectile_radius") or 0) or 24
    self.start_offset = tonumber(ability:GetSpecialValueFor("pierce_start_offset") or 0) or 64
    local pct = tonumber(ability:GetSpecialValueFor("pierce_damage_scale_pct") or 0) or 100
    self.damage_scale_mult = pct / 100

    enhance_common.RegisterAttackDamageScaleModifier(self:GetParent(), "drow_ranger_pierce", self.damage_scale_mult)
end

function modifier_drow_ranger_pierce:OnDestroy()
    if not IsServer() then return end
    enhance_common.UnregisterAttackDamageScaleModifier(self:GetParent(), "drow_ranger_pierce")
end

function modifier_drow_ranger_pierce:OnAttackLanded(params)
    if not IsServer() then return end
    if not params then return end
    local attacker = params.attacker
    local target = params.target
    if attacker ~= self:GetParent() then
        return
    end
    if not target or target:IsNull() then
        return
    end
    if not enhance_common.IsRangedAttacker(attacker) then
        return
    end
    if self.pierce_count <= 0 then
        return
    end

    local origin = attacker:GetAbsOrigin()
    local target_pos = target:GetAbsOrigin()
    local dir = target_pos - origin
    dir.z = 0
    if dir:Length2D() <= 1 then
        return
    end

LinkLuaModifier("modifier_drow_ranger_explode",
    "abilities/enhance/drow_ranger_explode.lua", LUA_MODIFIER_MOTION_NONE)

drow_ranger_explode = class({})

function drow_ranger_explode:GetIntrinsicModifierName()
    return "modifier_drow_ranger_explode"
end

modifier_drow_ranger_explode = class({})

function modifier_drow_ranger_explode:IsHidden() return true end
function modifier_drow_ranger_explode:IsPurgable() return false end
function modifier_drow_ranger_explode:RemoveOnDeath() return false end

function modifier_drow_ranger_explode:DeclareFunctions()
    return {
        MODIFIER_EVENT_ON_ATTACK_LANDED,
    }
end

function modifier_drow_ranger_explode:OnCreated()
    if not IsServer() then return end
    local ability = self:GetAbility()
    if not ability then
        return
    end
    self.explosion_radius = tonumber(ability:GetSpecialValueFor("explosion_radius") or 0) or 400
    self.explosion_damage_mult = tonumber(ability:GetSpecialValueFor("explosion_damage_mult") or 0) or 1
    self.explosion_hits_target = tonumber(ability:GetSpecialValueFor("explosion_hits_target") or 0) or 1
end

function modifier_drow_ranger_explode:OnAttackLanded(params)
    if not IsServer() then return end
    if not params then return end
    local attacker = params.attacker
    local target = params.target
    if attacker ~= self:GetParent() then
        return
    end
    if not target or target:IsNull() then
        return
    end
    if not enhance_common.IsRangedAttacker(attacker) then
        return
    end

    local owner = enhance_common.ResolveOwner(attacker)
    if not owner or owner:IsNull() then
        return
    end

    local mult = self.explosion_damage_mult or 1
    local bonus_ability = attacker:FindAbilityByName("drow_ranger_explode_2")
    if bonus_ability then
        local bonus = tonumber(bonus_ability:GetSpecialValueFor("explosion_damage_bonus") or 0) or 0
        mult = mult * (1 + bonus)
    end

    local origin = target:GetAbsOrigin()
    local enemies = FindUnitsInRadius(
        attacker:GetTeamNumber(),
        origin,
        nil,
        self.explosion_radius,
        DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_TEAM_ENEMY,
        DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_HERO + DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_BASIC,
        DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_FLAG_NONE,
        FIND_ANY_ORDER,
        false
    )

    for _, enemy in ipairs(enemies) do
        if enemy and not enemy:IsNull() then
            if self.explosion_hits_target ~= 1 and enemy == target then
                -- skip
            else
                enhance_common.ApplyProjectileDamage(owner, enemy, {
                    base_damage = 0,
                    damage_scale = mult,
                    pure_percent = 0,
                    ability = self:GetAbility(),
                })
            end
        end
    end
end

local enhance_common = require("abilities.enhance.enhance_common")

LinkLuaModifier("modifier_drow_ranger_knife",
    "abilities/enhance/drow_ranger_knife.lua", LUA_MODIFIER_MOTION_NONE)

drow_ranger_knife = class({})

function drow_ranger_knife:GetIntrinsicModifierName()
    return "modifier_drow_ranger_knife"
end

function drow_ranger_knife:OnProjectileHit_ExtraData(target, pos, data)
    if not IsServer() then return end
    if not target or target:IsNull() then
        return false
    end
    if not data then
        return false
    end

    local source = data.source_entindex and EntIndexToHScript(data.source_entindex) or nil
    local owner = data.owner_entindex and EntIndexToHScript(data.owner_entindex) or nil
    if not owner or owner:IsNull() then
        return true
    end

    enhance_common.ApplyProjectileDamage(owner, target, {
        base_damage = data.base_damage or 0,
        damage_scale = data.damage_scale or 1,
        pure_percent = data.pure_percent or 0,
        ability = self,
    })

    if source and not source:IsNull() and source:FindAbilityByName("drow_ranger_knife_explode") then
        local radius = 400
        local mult = 1
        local hits_target = 1
        local explode = source:FindAbilityByName("drow_ranger_explode")
        if explode then
            radius = tonumber(explode:GetSpecialValueFor("explosion_radius") or 0) or radius
            mult = tonumber(explode:GetSpecialValueFor("explosion_damage_mult") or 0) or mult
            hits_target = tonumber(explode:GetSpecialValueFor("explosion_hits_target") or 0) or hits_target
        end
        local bonus = source:FindAbilityByName("drow_ranger_explode_2")
        if bonus then
            local add = tonumber(bonus:GetSpecialValueFor("explosion_damage_bonus") or 0) or 0
            mult = mult * (1 + add)
        end

        local enemies = FindUnitsInRadius(
            owner:GetTeamNumber(),
            target:GetAbsOrigin(),
            nil,
            radius,
            DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_TEAM_ENEMY,
            DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_HERO + DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_BASIC,
            DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_FLAG_NONE,
            FIND_ANY_ORDER,
            false
        )
        for _, enemy in ipairs(enemies) do
            if enemy and not enemy:IsNull() then
                if hits_target ~= 1 and enemy == target then
                    -- skip
                else
                    enhance_common.ApplyProjectileDamage(owner, enemy, {
                        base_damage = 0,
                        damage_scale = mult,
                        pure_percent = 0,
                        ability = self,
                    })
                end
            end
        end
    end

    return true
end

modifier_drow_ranger_knife = class({})

function modifier_drow_ranger_knife:IsHidden() return true end
function modifier_drow_ranger_knife:IsPurgable() return false end
function modifier_drow_ranger_knife:RemoveOnDeath() return false end

function modifier_drow_ranger_knife:DeclareFunctions()
    return {
        MODIFIER_EVENT_ON_ATTACK_LANDED,
    }
end

function modifier_drow_ranger_knife:OnCreated()
    if not IsServer() then return end
    local ability = self:GetAbility()
    if not ability then
        return
    end
    self.knife_count = math.max(tonumber(ability:GetSpecialValueFor("knife_count") or 0) or 0, 0)
    self.knife_search_range = tonumber(ability:GetSpecialValueFor("knife_search_range") or 0) or 1000
    self.knife_speed = tonumber(ability:GetSpecialValueFor("knife_speed") or 0) or 1200
    self.knife_damage_mult = tonumber(ability:GetSpecialValueFor("knife_damage_mult") or 0) or 1
end

function modifier_drow_ranger_knife:OnAttackLanded(params)
    if not IsServer() then return end
    if not params then return end
    local attacker = params.attacker
    local target = params.target
    if attacker ~= self:GetParent() then
        return
    end
    if not target or target:IsNull() then
        return
    end
    if not enhance_common.IsRangedAttacker(attacker) then
        return
    end
    if self.knife_count <= 0 then
        return
    end

    local owner = enhance_common.ResolveOwner(attacker)
    if not owner or owner:IsNull() then
        return
    end

    local profile = enhance_common.GetAttackProfile(attacker)
    local base_damage = profile and profile.base_damage or 0
    local damage_scale = profile and profile.damage_scale or 1

    local sharp = attacker:FindAbilityByName("drow_ranger_knife_sharp")
    if sharp then
        local mult = tonumber(sharp:GetSpecialValueFor("knife_damage_mult") or 0) or 1
        damage_scale = damage_scale * mult
    end

    local enemies = FindUnitsInRadius(
        attacker:GetTeamNumber(),
        target:GetAbsOrigin(),
        nil,
        self.knife_search_range,
        DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_TEAM_ENEMY,
        DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_HERO + DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_BASIC,
        DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_FLAG_NONE,
        FIND_ANY_ORDER,
        false
    )

    if not enemies or #enemies == 0 then
        return
    end

    local launched = 0
    for _, enemy in ipairs(enemies) do
        if enemy and not enemy:IsNull() and enemy ~= target then
            local info = {
                Target = enemy,
                Source = attacker,
                Ability = self:GetAbility(),
                EffectName = attacker.GetRangedProjectileName and attacker:GetRangedProjectileName() or nil,
                iMoveSpeed = self.knife_speed,
                bDodgeable = true,
                bIsAttack = false,
                ExtraData = {
                    owner_entindex = owner:entindex(),
                    source_entindex = attacker:entindex(),
                    base_damage = base_damage,
                    damage_scale = damage_scale * self.knife_damage_mult,
                    pure_percent = profile and profile.pure_percent or 0,
                }
            }
            ProjectileManager:CreateTrackingProjectile(info)
            launched = launched + 1
            if launched >= self.knife_count then
                break
            end
        end
    end
end

local M = {}

function M.ResolveOwner(unit)
    if not unit or unit:IsNull() then
        return nil
    end
    if unit.__autocast_attack_owner and not unit.__autocast_attack_owner:IsNull() then
        return unit.__autocast_attack_owner
    end
    if unit.GetOwnerEntity then
        local owner = unit:GetOwnerEntity()
        if owner and not owner:IsNull() then
            return owner
        end
    end
    if unit.GetOwner then
        local owner = unit:GetOwner()
        if owner and not owner:IsNull() then
            return owner
        end
    end
    if unit.GetPlayerOwner then
        local player = unit:GetPlayerOwner()
        if player and player.GetAssignedHero then
            local hero = player:GetAssignedHero()
            if hero and not hero:IsNull() then
                return hero
            end
        end
    end
    return nil
end

function M.GetAttackProfile(attacker)
    if not attacker or attacker:IsNull() then
        return nil
    end
    local mod = attacker:FindModifierByName("modifier_dummy_autocast")
    if mod and mod.GetProfileForAbilityName then
        local profile = mod:GetProfileForAbilityName(nil)
        if profile then
            return profile
        end
    end
    if attacker.__autocast_attack_profile then
        return attacker.__autocast_attack_profile
    end
    return nil
end

function M.RegisterAttackDamageScaleModifier(unit, key, mult)
    if not unit or unit:IsNull() then
        return
    end
    local mod = unit:FindModifierByName("modifier_dummy_autocast")
    if mod and mod.RegisterAttackDamageScaleModifier then
        mod:RegisterAttackDamageScaleModifier(key, mult)
    end
end

function M.UnregisterAttackDamageScaleModifier(unit, key)
    if not unit or unit:IsNull() then
        return
    end
    local mod = unit:FindModifierByName("modifier_dummy_autocast")
    if mod and mod.UnregisterAttackDamageScaleModifier then
        mod:UnregisterAttackDamageScaleModifier(key)
    end
end

function M.ApplyProjectileDamage(attacker, victim, params)
    if not attacker or attacker:IsNull() then
        return
    end
    if not victim or victim:IsNull() then
        return
    end
    params = params or {}
    victim.hit_label = "projectile"
    victim.base_damage = params.base_damage or 0
    victim.damage_scale = params.damage_scale or 1
    victim.pure_percent = params.pure_percent or 0
    victim.career_damage_bonus_pct = 1
    ApplyDamage({
        attacker = attacker,
        victim = victim,
        damage = 1,
        damage_type = DAMAGE_TYPE_PHYSICAL,
        ability = params.ability,
    })
end

function M.IsRangedAttacker(unit)
    if not unit or unit:IsNull() then
        return false
    end
    if unit.IsRangedAttacker then
        return unit:IsRangedAttacker()
    end
    return false
end

return M

function modifier_dummy_autocast:UpdateAttackDamageScale()
    if not self.projectiles then
        return
    end
    local attack_profile = nil
    for _, profile in ipairs(self.projectiles) do
        if profile and profile.is_attack then
            attack_profile = profile
            break
        end
    end
    if not attack_profile then
        return
    end
    local base = attack_profile.base_damage_scale or attack_profile.damage_scale or 1
    local mult = 1
    if self.attack_damage_scale_mods then
        for _, value in pairs(self.attack_damage_scale_mods) do
            mult = mult * (tonumber(value) or 1)
        end
    end
    attack_profile.damage_scale = base * mult
end

function modifier_dummy_autocast:RegisterAttackDamageScaleModifier(key, mult)
    if not key then
        return
    end
    self.attack_damage_scale_mods = self.attack_damage_scale_mods or {}
    self.attack_damage_scale_mods[key] = mult or 1
    self:UpdateAttackDamageScale()
end

function modifier_dummy_autocast:UnregisterAttackDamageScaleModifier(key)
    if not key or not self.attack_damage_scale_mods then
        return
    end
    self.attack_damage_scale_mods[key] = nil
    self:UpdateAttackDamageScale()
end

function modifier_dummy_autocast:GetProfileForAbilityName(ability_name)
    if not self.projectiles then return nil end

    if not ability_name then
        for _, profile in ipairs(self.projectiles) do
            if profile.is_attack then
                return profile
            end
        end
        return nil
    end

    for _, profile in ipairs(self.projectiles) do
        if profile.projectile_name == ability_name then
            return profile
        end
    end

    return nil
end

            if IsSupportCareer(career) then
                local gold = CareerConfigKV[career].bonus_gold or 0
                PlayerResourceExt:AddAmount(self.pid, "gold", gold)
            end
        end
        if Shop1EnhanceManager and Shop1EnhanceManager.OnItemAcquired then

            if changed and self.SyncToClient then
                self:SyncToClient()
            end
        end
        if grant_enhance and tonumber(lvl) == 4 and Shop1EnhanceManager and Shop1EnhanceManager.StartSelection then
            local item_source = StripTrailingIndex(name)
            Timers:CreateTimer(0, function()
                Shop1EnhanceManager:StartSelection(self.pid, {
                    item_source = item_source,
                    force_unlocked = true,
                })
            end)
        end
    end
end

    local pid = self.pid

    end

    if not player then
        return
    end

    local hero = player:GetAssignedHero()
    if not hero then
        return
    end

    local items = {}
    for slot, data in pairs(self.Slots or {}) do
        if data and data ~= -1 then
            local raw_name = self:GetRawNameFromData(data)
            local level = self:GetDataLevel(data)
            if raw_name and level then
                table.insert(items, {
                    slot = slot,
                    raw_name = raw_name,
                    level = level,
                })
            end
        end
    end

    for _, item in ipairs(items) do

    for _, item in ipairs(items) do

    end
end

function Shop1Manager:FindSlotByDummy(dummy)
    if not dummy or dummy:IsNull() then return nil end
    dummy = self:ResolveShop1Dummy(dummy)
    if not dummy or dummy:IsNull() then return nil end

    local dummyIndex = dummy:GetEntityIndex()
    for slot, data in pairs(self.Slots) do
        if data and data ~= -1 and data.Dummy == dummyIndex then
            return slot, data
        end
    end

    return nil
end

function Shop1Manager:SelectNearestDummyByPos(pos, radius)
    if not pos then return end
    local bestEnt = nil
    local bestDist = nil
    for _, data in pairs(self.Slots or {}) do
        if data and data ~= -1 then
            local dummy = data.Dummy and EntIndexToHScript(data.Dummy)
            if dummy and not dummy:IsNull() then
                local selectEnt = dummy
                local proxyIndex = dummy.__shop1_selection_proxy
                if proxyIndex then
                    local proxy = EntIndexToHScript(proxyIndex)
                    if proxy and not proxy:IsNull() then
                        selectEnt = proxy
                    end
                end
                local dpos = selectEnt:GetAbsOrigin()
                local dist = (dpos - pos):Length2D()
                if dist <= radius and (not bestDist or dist < bestDist) then
                    bestDist = dist
                    bestEnt = selectEnt
                end
            end
        end
    end

    if bestEnt and PlayerResource and PlayerResource.NewSelection then
        PlayerResource:NewSelection(self.pid, { bestEnt:GetEntityIndex() })
    end
end

function Shop1Manager:ResolveShop1Dummy(unit)
    if not unit or unit:IsNull() then
        return unit
    end
    if unit.__shop1_proxy_dummy then
        local dummy = EntIndexToHScript(unit.__shop1_proxy_dummy)
        if dummy and not dummy:IsNull() then
            return dummy
        end
    end
    return unit
end

function Shop1Manager:GetDragMotionParams()
    return {
        max_duration = 0.75,
        min_duration = 0.25,
        max_distance = 0,
        snap_distance = 1,
        max_height = 400,
        steps = 30,
    }
end

function Shop1Manager:GetGoodPointPos(slot)
    local points = GameState.spawn_points[self.pid] and GameState.spawn_points[self.pid].good
    if not points then return nil end
    return points[slot]
end

function Shop1Manager:GetMaxDragDistance()
    local points = GameState.spawn_points[self.pid] and GameState.spawn_points[self.pid].good
    if not points then return nil end

    local positions = {}
    for _, pos in pairs(points) do
        table.insert(positions, pos)
    end

    local maxDist = 0
    for i = 1, #positions do
        for j = i + 1, #positions do
            local dist = (positions[i] - positions[j]):Length2D()
            if dist > maxDist then
                maxDist = dist
            end
        end
    end

    return maxDist
end

function Shop1Manager:GetDummyUnitName(data)
    if not data then return nil end
    local dummy = data.Dummy and EntIndexToHScript(data.Dummy)
    if not dummy or dummy:IsNull() then return nil end
    return dummy:GetUnitName()
end

function Shop1Manager:GetRawNameFromData(data)
    if not data then return nil end
    local stats = data.Stats
    if stats and not stats:IsNull() then
        local ab = stats:GetAbility()
        if ab then
            local name = ab:GetAbilityName()
            return StripTrailingIndex(name)
        end
    end
    local autocast = data.Autocast
    if autocast and not autocast:IsNull() then
        local ab = autocast:GetAbility()
        if ab then
            local name = ab:GetAbilityName()
            return StripTrailingIndex(name)
        end
    end
    return nil
end

function Shop1Manager:GetHeroFromData(data)
    if not data then return nil end
    if data.Autocast and not data.Autocast:IsNull() then
        local parent = data.Autocast:GetParent()
        if parent and not parent:IsNull() then
            return parent
        end
    end
    if data.Stats and not data.Stats:IsNull() then
        local parent = data.Stats:GetParent()
        if parent and not parent:IsNull() then
            return parent
        end
    end
    return nil
end

function Shop1Manager:GetDataLevel(data)
    if not data then return nil end
    return (data.Autocast and data.Autocast.custom_level) or (data.Stats and data.Stats.custom_level)
end

function Shop1Manager:PrepareDummyForSynthesize(data)
    if not data then
        return
    end
    local dummy = data.Dummy and EntIndexToHScript(data.Dummy) or nil
    if dummy and not dummy:IsNull() then
        dummy.__autocast_destroying = true
        if WorldPanels and WorldPanels.DeletePanelsForEntity then
            WorldPanels:DeletePanelsForEntity(dummy)
        end
        if dummy.Stop then
            dummy:Stop()
        end
        if dummy.SetForceAttackTarget then
            dummy:SetForceAttackTarget(nil)
        end
        dummy:RemoveModifierByName("modifier_dummy_autocast")
    end
    local autocast = data.Autocast
    if autocast and not autocast:IsNull() then
        autocast.is_paused = true
    end
end

function Shop1Manager:CanSynthesizePair(dataA, dataB)
    if not dataA or not dataB then return false end
    if dataA.Moving or dataB.Moving then return false end

    local levelA = self:GetDataLevel(dataA)
    local levelB = self:GetDataLevel(dataB)
    if not levelA or not levelB or levelA ~= levelB then return false end
    if levelA >= 4 then return false end

    local nameA = self:GetDummyUnitName(dataA)
    local nameB = self:GetDummyUnitName(dataB)
    if not nameA or not nameB or nameA ~= nameB then return false end

    return true, levelA
end

function Shop1Manager:SynthesizePairSlotsImmediate(slotA, slotB, targetSlot)
    if not slotA or not slotB then return false end

    local dataA = self.Slots[slotA]
    local dataB = self.Slots[slotB]
    if not dataA or dataA == -1 or not dataB or dataB == -1 then return false end

    local ok, level = self:CanSynthesizePair(dataA, dataB)
    if not ok then return false end

    if not targetSlot then
        local slotsRemoved = { slotA, slotB }
        targetSlot = slotsRemoved[RandomInt(1, #slotsRemoved)]
    end

    local equipName = (#self.equip_pool > 0) and self.equip_pool[RandomInt(1, #self.equip_pool)] or nil

    self:PrepareDummyForSynthesize(dataA)
    self:PrepareDummyForSynthesize(dataB)

    local entA = dataA and dataA.Dummy or nil
    local entB = dataB and dataB.Dummy or nil

    self:RemoveItem(slotA)
    self.Slots[slotA] = -1

    Timers:CreateTimer(0.03, function()
        self:RemoveItem(slotB)
        self.Slots[slotB] = -1

        local player = PlayerResource:GetPlayer(self.pid)
        local hero = (player and player:GetAssignedHero()) or self:GetHeroFromData(dataA)
        if hero then
            if equipName then
                Shop1Managers:DebugLog("Synthesize immediate add", equipName, "lvl", level + 1, "slot", targetSlot)
                self:AddItem(hero, equipName, level + 1, targetSlot, false, nil, true)
            else
                Shop1Managers:DebugLog("Synthesize immediate failed, no equipName", slotA, slotB)
            end
        else
            Shop1Managers:DebugLog("Synthesize immediate failed, no hero", slotA, slotB)
        end
    end)

    return true
end

function Shop1Manager:SynthesizePairSlotsAnimated(slotMover, slotTarget, targetSlot, moveBoth)
    if not slotMover or not slotTarget then return false end

    local dataA = self.Slots[slotMover]
    local dataB = self.Slots[slotTarget]
    if not dataA or dataA == -1 or not dataB or dataB == -1 then return false end

    local ok, level = self:CanSynthesizePair(dataA, dataB)
    if not ok then return false end

    if not targetSlot then
        local slotsRemoved = { slotMover, slotTarget }
        targetSlot = slotsRemoved[RandomInt(1, #slotsRemoved)]

    self:PrepareDummyForSynthesize(dataB)

    local function ResolveSlotByData(findData)

            end
        end
        return nil
    end

        local slotA = ResolveSlotByData(dataA) or slotMover

        local entB = dataB and dataB.Dummy or nil
        -- print(string.format("[SYN][Animated] source=Animated pid=%s slotA=%s slotB=%s target=%s lvl=%s entA=%s entB=%s time=%.3f",

        --     tostring(entA), tostring(entB), GameRules:GetGameTime()))
        self:RemoveItem(slotA)
        self.Slots[slotA] = -1

        Timers:CreateTimer(0.03, function()
            self:RemoveItem(slotB)

            local player = PlayerResource:GetPlayer(self.pid)
            local hero = (player and player:GetAssignedHero()) or self:GetHeroFromData(dataA)
            if hero then
                if equipName then

                    self:AddItem(hero, equipName, level + 1, targetSlot, false, nil, true)

function Shop1Manager:AnimateDataToPos(data, targetPos, params, onFinish)
    if not data or not targetPos then
        if onFinish then onFinish() end
        return
    end

    local dummy = data.Dummy and EntIndexToHScript(data.Dummy)
    if not dummy or dummy:IsNull() then
        if onFinish then onFinish() end
        return
    end

    local dummy_sp = data.Autocast and data.Autocast.dummy_sp or nil

    params = params or self:GetDragMotionParams()
    local maxDuration = tonumber(params.max_duration) or tonumber(params.duration) or 1.0
    local minDuration = tonumber(params.min_duration) or 0
    local maxHeight = tonumber(params.max_height) or tonumber(params.height) or 200
    local steps = tonumber(params.steps) or 30
    local snapDistance = tonumber(params.snap_distance) or 0
    local maxDistance = tonumber(params.max_distance)
    if not maxDistance or maxDistance <= 0 then
        maxDistance = self:GetMaxDragDistance() or 0
    end
    if steps < 1 then steps = 1 end

    local startPos = dummy:GetAbsOrigin()
    local dist = (targetPos - startPos):Length2D()
    if dist <= snapDistance then
        local main_pos = nil
        if data.Autocast and data.Autocast.UpdateFormationAtPos then
            main_pos = data.Autocast:UpdateFormationAtPos(targetPos)
        else
            dummy:SetAbsOrigin(targetPos)
            main_pos = targetPos
        end
        if dummy_sp and not dummy_sp:IsNull() then
            dummy_sp:SetAbsOrigin(main_pos or targetPos)
        end
        if onFinish then onFinish() end
        return
    end

    if maxDistance <= 0 then
        maxDistance = dist
    end

    local distanceScale = math.min(dist / maxDistance, 1)
    local duration = maxDuration * distanceScale
    if duration < minDuration then
        duration = minDuration
    end
    if duration <= 0.03 then
        local main_pos = nil
        if data.Autocast and data.Autocast.UpdateFormationAtPos then
            main_pos = data.Autocast:UpdateFormationAtPos(targetPos)
        else
            dummy:SetAbsOrigin(targetPos)
            main_pos = targetPos
        end
        if dummy_sp and not dummy_sp:IsNull() then
            dummy_sp:SetAbsOrigin(main_pos or targetPos)
        end
        if onFinish then onFinish() end
        return
    end

    local stepCount = math.floor(steps * (duration / maxDuration))
    if stepCount < 1 then stepCount = 1 end
    local height = maxHeight * distanceScale

    Shop1Managers:MotionLog("Move", string.format("dist=%.1f", dist), string.format("scale=%.2f", distanceScale),
        string.format("dur=%.2f", duration), string.format("height=%.1f", height), "steps", stepCount)

    local step = 0
    local interval = duration / stepCount

    data.Moving = true

    Timers:CreateTimer(0, function()
        if not dummy or dummy:IsNull() then
            data.Moving = false
            if onFinish then onFinish() end
            return
        end

        local t = step / stepCount
        if t > 1 then t = 1 end

        local base = startPos + (targetPos - startPos) * t
        local z = startPos.z + (targetPos.z - startPos.z) * t + height * math.sin(math.pi * t)
        local pos = Vector(base.x, base.y, z)

        local main_pos = nil
        if data.Autocast and data.Autocast.UpdateFormationAtPos then
            main_pos = data.Autocast:UpdateFormationAtPos(pos)
        else
            dummy:SetAbsOrigin(pos)
            main_pos = pos
        end
        if GoodForward then
            dummy:SetForwardVector(GoodForward)
        end

        if dummy_sp and not dummy_sp:IsNull() then
            dummy_sp:SetAbsOrigin(main_pos or pos)
        end

        if t >= 1 then
            data.Moving = false
            if onFinish then onFinish() end
            return
        end

        step = step + 1
        return interval
    end)
end

function Shop1Manager:FindNearestGoodSlot(pos, radius)
    local points = GameState.spawn_points[self.pid] and GameState.spawn_points[self.pid].good
    if not points then return nil end

    local nearestSlot = nil
    local nearestDist = radius or 0

    for slot, pointPos in pairs(points) do
        local dist = (pointPos - pos):Length2D()
        if dist <= nearestDist then
            nearestDist = dist
            nearestSlot = slot
        end
    end

    return nearestSlot
end

function Shop1Manager:FindSynthesizeTargetSlotByPos(currentSlot, targetPos, radius)
    if not currentSlot or not targetPos then return nil end

    local dataA = self.Slots[currentSlot]
    if not dataA or dataA == -1 then return nil end

    local maxDist = radius or 200
    local bestSlot = nil
    local bestDist = nil

    for slot, dataB in pairs(self.Slots) do
        if slot ~= currentSlot and dataB and dataB ~= -1 then
            local dummy = dataB.Dummy and EntIndexToHScript(dataB.Dummy)
            local pos = (dummy and not dummy:IsNull()) and dummy:GetAbsOrigin() or self:GetGoodPointPos(slot)
            if pos then
                local dist = (pos - targetPos):Length2D()
                if dist <= maxDist then
                    local ok = self:CanSynthesizePair(dataA, dataB)
                    if ok and (not bestDist or dist < bestDist) then
                        bestDist = dist
                        bestSlot = slot
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end

    return bestSlot
end

function Shop1Manager:AddItemLevel(hero, lvl)
    if not self.Slots then
        return
    end

    if next(self.Slots) == nil then
        return
    end

    for slot, value in pairs(self.Slots) do
        if type(value) == "table" then
            local stats = value.Stats

            if not stats then
                goto continue
            end

            if stats:IsNull() then
                goto continue
            end

            local level = stats.custom_level + (lvl or 1)

            if level > 4 then
                return
            end

            local ability = stats:GetAbility()
            if not ability then
                goto continue
            end

            local name = ability:GetAbilityName()
            local raw_name = StripTrailingIndex(name)

            self:RemoveItem(slot)
            self:AddItem(hero, raw_name, level, slot)

            return
        end
        ::continue::
    end
end

function Shop1Manager:AddItemLevelAll(hero, lvl)
    for slot, value in pairs(self.Slots) do
        if type(value) == "table" then
            local stats = value.Stats
            if not stats then
                goto continue
            end

            if stats:IsNull() then
                goto continue
            end

            local level = stats.custom_level + (lvl or 1)

            if level > 4 then
                return
            end

            local ability = stats:GetAbility()
            if not ability then
                goto continue
            end

            local name = ability:GetAbilityName()
            local raw_name = StripTrailingIndex(name)

            self:RemoveItem(slot)
            self:AddItem(hero, raw_name, level, slot)
        end
        ::continue::
    end
end

function Shop1Manager:Synthesize(hero)
    if not hero or hero:IsNull() then return end

    local slots = self.Slots
    local slotInfos = {}

    for slot, data in pairs(slots) do
        if data and data.Autocast ~= -1 then
            local autocast = data.Autocast
            if autocast and autocast.custom_level and autocast.custom_level < 4 then
                local lv = autocast.custom_level
                local unitName = self:GetDummyUnitName(data)
                if unitName then
                    slotInfos[lv] = slotInfos[lv] or {}
                    slotInfos[lv][unitName] = slotInfos[lv][unitName] or {}
                    table.insert(slotInfos[lv][unitName], slot)
                end
            end
        end
    end

    for _, nameMap in pairs(slotInfos) do
        for _, points in pairs(nameMap) do
            while #points >= 2 do
                local slotA = table.remove(points)
                local slotB = table.remove(points)
                self:SynthesizePairSlotsImmediate(slotA, slotB)
            end
        end
    end
end

function Shop1Manager:RemoveItem(slot)
    local data = self.Slots[slot]
    if not data or data == -1 then
        self.Slots[slot] = -1
        return
    end
    local dummy_name = self:GetDummyUnitName(data) or "nil"
    local dummy_ent = data and data.Dummy or nil
    local stats = data and data.Stats or nil
    local autocast = data and data.Autocast or nil
    local stats_id = tostring(stats)
    local autocast_id = tostring(autocast)
    local level = self:GetDataLevel(data) or "nil"
    self.Slots[slot] = -1

    local dummy = data.Dummy and EntIndexToHScript(data.Dummy) or nil
    if dummy and not dummy:IsNull() then
        dummy.__autocast_destroying = true
        if WorldPanels and WorldPanels.DeletePanelsForEntity then
            WorldPanels:DeletePanelsForEntity(dummy)
        end
        if self.pid and PlayerResource and PlayerResource.GetSelectedEntities then
            local selected = PlayerResource:GetSelectedEntities(self.pid) or {}
            for _, ent in pairs(selected) do
                if ent == data.Dummy and PlayerResource.ResetSelection then
                    PlayerResource:ResetSelection(self.pid)
                    break
                end
            end
        end
        ExecuteOrderFromTable({
            UnitIndex = dummy:entindex(),
            OrderType = DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_STOP,
            Queue = false,
        })
        local mod = dummy:FindModifierByName("modifier_dummy_autocast")
        if mod then
            mod.is_paused = true
        end
        if dummy.Stop then
            dummy:Stop()
        end
        if dummy.SetForceAttackTarget then
            dummy:SetForceAttackTarget(nil)
        end
    end

    if autocast and not autocast:IsNull() then
        autocast.is_paused = true
        local parent = autocast:GetParent()
        if parent and not parent:IsNull() then
            if parent.Stop then
                parent:Stop()
            end
            if parent.SetForceAttackTarget then
                parent:SetForceAttackTarget(nil)
            end
        end
    end

    Timers:CreateTimer(0.1, function()
        if stats and not stats:IsNull() then
            stats:Destroy()
        end
        if autocast and not autocast:IsNull() then
            autocast:Destroy()
        end
        return nil
    end)
end

function Shop1Manager:DestroyAllItems(hero)
    -- print("[Shop] DestroyAllItems")

    for key, value in pairs(self.Slots) do
        self:RemoveItem(key)
    end
end

Shop1Manager.item_cache = {}

function Shop1Manager:RemoveAndStoreItems(hero)
    self.item_cache = {}

    for key, value in pairs(self.Slots) do
        if value and value.Stats then
            local stats = value.Stats
            if stats then
                local ability = stats:GetAbility()
                local level = stats.custom_level
                local name = nil
                if ability then
                    name = ability.raw_name or ability:GetAbilityName()
                    if name and level then
                        local suffix = "_" .. tostring(level)
                        if name:sub(- #suffix) == suffix then

local autocast_common = require("projectiles.autocast_common")
local autocast_item_config = require("projectiles.autocast_item_config")

local DEFAULT_REVEAL_DELAY = 0.05

local function NormalizeCareer(raw)
    if raw == nil then
        return nil
    end
    local s = tostring(raw)
    if s == "" or s == "none" then
        return nil
    end
    return s
end

local function GetSafeTeamNumber(unit)
    local team = DOTA_TEAM_GOODGUYS
    if unit and unit.GetTeamNumber then
        team = unit:GetTeamNumber()
    end
    if not team or team < DOTA_TEAM_GOODGUYS or team > DOTA_TEAM_CUSTOM_8 then
        team = DOTA_TEAM_GOODGUYS
    end
    return team
end

local DummyPool = {}

local function GetRightVector(forward)
    if not forward then
        return Vector(1, 0, 0)
    end
    local right = Vector(forward.y, -forward.x, 0)
    if right:Length2D() < 0.01 then
        return Vector(1, 0, 0)
    end
    return right:Normalized()
end

local function GetHullRadiusSafe(unit)
    if unit and unit.GetHullRadius then
        local r = unit:GetHullRadius()
        if r and r > 0 then
            return r
        end
    end
    return 24
end

local function GetFormationOffset(unit)
    local name = unit and unit.GetUnitName and unit:GetUnitName() or nil
    local kv = name and UnitsKV and UnitsKV[name] or nil
    local offset = kv and tonumber(kv.Offset) or 0

    if not offset then
        return 0
    end
    return offset
end

local function SetUnselectable(unit, enable)
    if not unit or unit:IsNull() then
        return
    end
    if enable then
        if not unit:HasModifier("modifier_shop1_dummy_unselectable") then
            unit:AddNewModifier(unit, nil, "modifier_shop1_dummy_unselectable", {})
        end
    else
        unit:RemoveModifierByName("modifier_shop1_dummy_unselectable")
    end
end

local function TakeDummyFromPool(name)
    local pool = DummyPool[name]
    if not pool then
        return nil
    end
    while #pool > 0 do
        local dummy = table.remove(pool)
        if dummy and not dummy:IsNull() then
            return dummy
        end
    end
    return nil
end

local function ReturnDummyToPool(name, dummy)
    if not name or not dummy or dummy:IsNull() then
        return
    end
    DummyPool[name] = DummyPool[name] or {}
    table.insert(DummyPool[name], dummy)
end

local function PrepareDummyForPool(dummy)
    if not dummy or dummy:IsNull() then
        return
    end
    if WorldPanels and WorldPanels.DeletePanelsForEntity then
        WorldPanels:DeletePanelsForEntity(dummy)
    end
    dummy.__autocast_destroying = true
    dummy:AddNoDraw()
    dummy:RemoveModifierByName("modifier_dummy_autocast")
    dummy:RemoveModifierByName("modifier_autocast_dummy_attrs")
    if dummy.SetForceAttackTarget then
        dummy:SetForceAttackTarget(nil)
    end
    if dummy.Stop then
        dummy:Stop()
    end
    dummy:SetAbsOrigin(Vector(10000, 10000, 0))
    if not dummy:HasModifier("modifier_invulnerable") then
        dummy:AddNewModifier(dummy, nil, "modifier_invulnerable", {})
    end
    if not dummy:HasModifier("modifier_no_healthbar") then
        dummy:AddNewModifier(dummy, nil, "modifier_no_healthbar", {})
    end
end

function modifier_item_autocast_controller:IsHidden() return true end

function modifier_item_autocast_controller:IsPurgable() return false end

function modifier_item_autocast_controller:RemoveOnDeath() return false end

function modifier_item_autocast_controller:GetAttributes()
    return MODIFIER_ATTRIBUTE_MULTIPLE
end

function modifier_item_autocast_controller:CancelRevealTimer()
    if self.reveal_timer then
        Timers:RemoveTimer(self.reveal_timer)
        self.reveal_timer = nil
    end
end

function modifier_item_autocast_controller:DeleteWorldPanel()
    if self.worldPanel then
        self.worldPanel:Delete()
        self.worldPanel = nil
    end
end

function modifier_item_autocast_controller:HideAllVisuals()
    self.is_revealed = false
    self:CancelRevealTimer()
    self:DeleteWorldPanel()
    local function hide_unit(u)
        if u and not u:IsNull() then
            u:AddNoDraw()
        end
    end
    hide_unit(self.dummy)
    if self.visual_dummies then
        for _, v in ipairs(self.visual_dummies) do

        end

function modifier_item_autocast_controller:RevealAllVisuals(panel_entity)
    self:CancelRevealTimer()

            u:RemoveNoDraw()
        end

        end

        self:EnsureStarWorldPanelForEntity(panel_entity)

end

function modifier_item_autocast_controller:ScheduleReveal(panel_entity, should_reveal)
    if not should_reveal then

        return
    end
    if self.is_revealed then
        return
    end
    self:CancelRevealTimer()
    local delay = self.reveal_delay or DEFAULT_REVEAL_DELAY
    self.reveal_timer = Timers:CreateTimer(delay or 0, function()
        self:RevealAllVisuals(panel_entity)
        self.reveal_timer = nil
        return nil
    end)
end

function modifier_item_autocast_controller:OnCreated()
    if not IsServer() then return end

    local parent  = self:GetParent() --hero
    local ability = self:GetAbility()

        local raw_kv_withlevel = AbilityKV[ability:GetAbilityName()]

        self.custom_level      = tonumber(ability.custom_level) or tonumber(self.lvl) or 1

            local overrides = Shop1EnhanceManager:GetOverrideValues(pid, ability.raw_name, self.custom_level,
                base_item_kv)
            if overrides then
                effect_overrides = overrides.__effect_overrides
                overrides.__effect_overrides = nil
                raw_kv = NewTable(raw_kv_withlevel)
                raw_kv.AbilityValues = NewTable(raw_kv_withlevel.AbilityValues or {})
                for key, value in pairs(overrides) do
                    if raw_kv.AbilityValues[key] ~= nil then
                        raw_kv.AbilityValues[key] = tostring(value)
                    else
                        raw_kv[key] = value
                    end
                end
            end
        end

        self.hero_name       = raw_kv.HeroName

        self:ModifyHero(raw_kv, parent)

        if self.projectile_name == "" then

        end

        self.reveal_delay = DEFAULT_REVEAL_DELAY

        local config = autocast_item_config.Read(raw_kv)
        local base_item_kv = Shop1ItemsKV and Shop1ItemsKV[ability.raw_name] or nil
        if not base_item_kv and Shop1ItemsKV and Shop1ItemsKV["Shop1 Items"] then
            base_item_kv = Shop1ItemsKV["Shop1 Items"][ability.raw_name]
        end
        local career = NormalizeCareer(base_item_kv and base_item_kv.Career)
        config.career = career

        local additional_effects = autocast_item_config.ReadEffects(base_item_kv, self.custom_level, "AdditionalEffect")
        if effect_overrides then
            if effect_overrides.replace and #effect_overrides.replace > 0 then
                effects = effect_overrides.replace
            end
            if effect_overrides.additional and #effect_overrides.additional > 0 then
                additional_effects = additional_effects or {}
                for _, entry in ipairs(effect_overrides.additional) do
                    table.insert(additional_effects, entry)
                end
            end
        end
        config.effects = effects
        config.additional_effects = additional_effects
        for key, value in pairs(config) do
            self[key] = value
        end

        self:CreateDummy(parent, ability)
    end)
end

local function ApplyHeroPassive(parent, name, level, label)

function modifier_item_autocast_controller:ModifyHero(raw_kv_withlevel, parent)
    if raw_kv_withlevel.HeroPassive and raw_kv_withlevel.HeroPassive ~= "" and raw_kv_withlevel.HeroPassive ~= "none" then

        self.hero_modifier_sp = raw_kv_withlevel.HeroModifierSP

        if not self.mod then

    if raw_kv_withlevel.Skill and raw_kv_withlevel.Skill ~= "" and raw_kv_withlevel.Skill ~= "none" then
        self.skill = raw_kv_withlevel.Skill

        if raw_kv_withlevel.SkillPurePercent and tonumber(raw_kv_withlevel.SkillPurePercent) > 0 then

        end

        end

        end

        self.skill_listener = parent:AddNewModifier(parent, ability, "modifier_item_cast_listener", {
            ability_name = self.skill,

end

function modifier_item_autocast_controller:GetFormationCount()
    local lvl = tonumber(self.custom_level) or tonumber(self.lvl) or 1
    if lvl == 2 then
        return 2
    end
    if lvl == 3 then
        return 3
    end
    return 1
end

function modifier_item_autocast_controller:EnsureVisualDummies(count)
    if not self.dummy or self.dummy:IsNull() then
        return
    end

    self.visual_dummies = self.visual_dummies or {}
    local need = math.max(0, (count or 1) - 1)
    local offset = GetFormationOffset(self.dummy)

    if need <= 0 then
        for _, v in ipairs(self.visual_dummies) do
            if v and not v:IsNull() then
                v:Destroy()
            end
        end
        self.visual_dummies = {}
        self.dummy.__shop1_visual_dummies = nil
        self.dummy.__shop1_visual_dummies_last = nil
        SetUnselectable(self.dummy, false)
        return
    end

    while #self.visual_dummies > need do
        local v = table.remove(self.visual_dummies)
        if v and not v:IsNull() then
            v:Destroy()
        end
    end

    local team = GetSafeTeamNumber(self.dummy)
    local owner = self.dummy:GetOwner() or self.dummy
    local name = self.dummy:GetUnitName()

    while #self.visual_dummies < need do
        local v = CreateUnitByName(
            name,
            self.dummy:GetAbsOrigin(),
            false,
            owner,
            owner,
            team
        )
        if v then
            v:SetOwner(owner)
            if owner and owner.GetPlayerOwnerID then
                v:SetControllableByPlayer(owner:GetPlayerOwnerID(), false)
            end

            if v.SetAttackCapability then
                v:SetAttackCapability(DOTA_UNIT_CAP_NO_ATTACK)
            end
            if v.SetAttackAcquisitionRange then
                v:SetAttackAcquisitionRange(0)
            end

            v:AddNewModifier(v, nil, "modifier_invulnerable", {})
            v:AddNewModifier(v, nil, "modifier_phased", {})
            v:AddNewModifier(v, nil, "modifier_rooted", {})
            if not v:HasModifier("modifier_no_healthbar") then
                v:AddNewModifier(v, nil, "modifier_no_healthbar", {})
            end
            SetUnselectable(v, true)
            v:AddNoDraw()
            -- print(string.format("[Shop1Dummy][visual] ent=%s offset=%s",
            --     tostring(v:GetEntityIndex()),
            --     tostring(offset)))
            local selectable = (v.IsUnselectable and not v:IsUnselectable()) or false
            -- print(string.format("[Shop1Dummy][visual] ent=%s selectable=%s",
            --     tostring(v:GetEntityIndex()),
            --     tostring(selectable)))
            table.insert(self.visual_dummies, v)
        else
            break
        end
    end

    self.dummy.__shop1_visual_dummies = self.visual_dummies
    self.dummy.__shop1_visual_dummies_last = self.visual_dummies
end

function modifier_item_autocast_controller:EnsureSelectionProxy(center_pos, max_radius)
    local count = self:GetFormationCount()
    if count <= 1 then
        if self.selection_proxy and not self.selection_proxy:IsNull() then
            self.selection_proxy:Destroy()
        end
        self.selection_proxy = nil
        if self.dummy and not self.dummy:IsNull() then
            self.dummy.__shop1_selection_proxy = nil
        end
        return
    end

    if not self.selection_proxy or self.selection_proxy:IsNull() then
        local owner = self.dummy and self.dummy:GetOwner() or nil
        local team = GetSafeTeamNumber(self.dummy)
        local name = self.dummy and self.dummy:GetUnitName() or "npc_dota_auto_cast_dummy"
        local proxy = CreateUnitByName(
            name,
            center_pos or Vector(0, 0, 0),
            false,
            owner,
            owner,
            team
        )
        if proxy then
            proxy:SetOwner(owner)
            if owner and owner.GetPlayerOwnerID then
                proxy:SetControllableByPlayer(owner:GetPlayerOwnerID(), false)
            end
            proxy:AddNewModifier(proxy, nil, "modifier_invulnerable", {})
            proxy:AddNewModifier(proxy, nil, "modifier_phased", {})
            proxy:AddNewModifier(proxy, nil, "modifier_rooted", {})
            if not proxy:HasModifier("modifier_no_healthbar") then
                proxy:AddNewModifier(proxy, nil, "modifier_no_healthbar", {})
            end

            proxy:AddNoDraw()

            SetUnselectable(proxy, false)
            local selectable = (proxy.IsUnselectable and not proxy:IsUnselectable()) or false
            -- print(string.format("[Shop1Dummy][proxy] ent=%s selectable=%s",
            --     tostring(proxy:GetEntityIndex()),
            --     tostring(selectable)))
            proxy.__shop1_proxy_dummy = self.dummy and self.dummy:GetEntityIndex() or nil
            self.selection_proxy = proxy
            if self.dummy and not self.dummy:IsNull() then
                self.dummy.__shop1_selection_proxy = proxy:GetEntityIndex()
            end
        end
    end

    if self.selection_proxy and not self.selection_proxy:IsNull() then
        if center_pos then
            self.selection_proxy:SetAbsOrigin(center_pos)
        end
        if max_radius and self.selection_proxy.SetHullRadius then
            self.selection_proxy:SetHullRadius(max_radius)
        end
        if GoodForward then
            self.selection_proxy:SetForwardVector(GoodForward)
        end
    end
end

function modifier_item_autocast_controller:UpdateFormationAtPos(center_pos)
    if not self.dummy or self.dummy:IsNull() then
        return nil
    end
    if not center_pos then
        return nil
    end

    local count = self:GetFormationCount()
    self:EnsureVisualDummies(count)

    local forward = GoodForward or self.dummy:GetForwardVector() or Vector(0, 1, 0)
    local right = GetRightVector(forward)
    local base_r = GetHullRadiusSafe(self.dummy)
    local offset = GetFormationOffset(self.dummy)
    local r = base_r + offset
    local s = r * 2
    local h = s * 0.8660254

    local positions = {}
    if count == 1 then
        positions[1] = center_pos
    elseif count == 2 then
        positions[1] = center_pos - right * r
        positions[2] = center_pos + right * r
    elseif count == 3 then
        positions[1] = center_pos + forward * (2 * h / 3)
        positions[2] = center_pos + right * (-s / 2) + forward * (-h / 3)
        positions[3] = center_pos + right * (s / 2) + forward * (-h / 3)
    end

    if positions[1] then
        self.dummy:SetAbsOrigin(positions[1])
    end
    if self.visual_dummies then
        for i, v in ipairs(self.visual_dummies) do
            local pos = positions[i + 1]
            if v and not v:IsNull() and pos then
                v:SetAbsOrigin(pos)
                if v.SetForwardVector then
                    v:SetForwardVector(forward)
                end
            end
        end
    end
    if count > 1 then
        local max_dist = 0
        for _, pos in ipairs(positions) do
            local dist = (pos - center_pos):Length2D()
            if dist > max_dist then
                max_dist = dist
            end
        end
        self:EnsureSelectionProxy(center_pos, max_dist + r)
        SetUnselectable(self.dummy, true)
        local main_selectable = (self.dummy.IsUnselectable and not self.dummy:IsUnselectable()) or false
        -- print(string.format("[Shop1Dummy][main] ent=%s selectable=%s",
        --     tostring(self.dummy:GetEntityIndex()),
        --     tostring(main_selectable)))
        self:DeleteWorldPanel()
    else
        self:EnsureSelectionProxy(nil, nil)
        SetUnselectable(self.dummy, false)
        local main_selectable = (self.dummy.IsUnselectable and not self.dummy:IsUnselectable()) or false
        -- print(string.format("[Shop1Dummy][main] ent=%s selectable=%s",
        --     tostring(self.dummy:GetEntityIndex()),
        --     tostring(main_selectable)))
        self:DeleteWorldPanel()
    end
    local main_pos = positions[1]
    local should_reveal = main_pos and main_pos:Length2D() < 9000
    local panel_entity = (count > 1) and self.selection_proxy or self.dummy
    self:ScheduleReveal(panel_entity, should_reveal)
    return main_pos
end

function modifier_item_autocast_controller:CreateDummy(parent, ability)
    local dummy_name = "npc_dota_auto_cast_dummy" .. "_" .. self.hero_name .. "_" .. self.lvl

    local team = GetSafeTeamNumber(parent)
    self.is_revealed = false
    local pooled = TakeDummyFromPool(dummy_name)
    if pooled then
        self.dummy = pooled
        self.dummy.__autocast_destroying = nil
        self.dummy:AddNoDraw()
        self.dummy:RemoveModifierByName("modifier_invulnerable")
        self.dummy:RemoveModifierByName("modifier_no_healthbar")

        self.worldPanel:Delete()
        self.worldPanel = nil
    end

end

function modifier_item_autocast_controller:EnsureStarWorldPanelForEntity(entity)
    if not entity or entity:IsNull() then
        return
    end

    if not WorldPanels then
        return
    end

    if self.worldPanel then
        self.worldPanel:Delete()
        self.worldPanel = nil
    end

    local level = math.max(1, math.min(tonumber(self.custom_level) or tonumber(self.lvl) or 1, 6))
    local stars = string.rep("★", level)

    self.worldPanel = WorldPanels:CreateWorldPanelForAll({

        entityHeight = 100,
        horizontalAlign = "center",
        verticalAlign = "bottom",

        data = {
            stars = stars,
            level = level,
        },
    })

    if not self.worldPanel then
        print("[WorldPanel Error] CreateWorldPanelForAll returned nil")
    end
end

local function ResolveEnhanceValue(raw, level)
    if raw == nil then
        return nil
    end
    if type(raw) == "number" then
        return raw
    end
    local s = tostring(raw)
    if s == "" then
        return nil
    end

    local num = tonumber(s)
    if num then
        return num
    end

    local nums = ParseArray(s)
    if #nums > 0 then
        return nums[math.min(level, #nums)]
    end

    local strs = ParseStringArray(s)
    if #strs > 0 then
        return strs[math.min(level, #strs)]
    end

    return s
end

local function GetEnhanceWeight(cfg)
    local weight = tonumber(cfg and cfg.Weight or 1) or 1
    if weight < 0 then
        weight = 0
    end
    if weight > 1000 then
        weight = 1000
    end
    return weight
end

local function PickWeighted(list, weight_fn)
    if not list or #list == 0 then
        return nil, nil
    end
    local total = 0
    for _, name in ipairs(list) do
        local w = tonumber(weight_fn(name)) or 0
        if w > 0 then
            total = total + w
        end
    end
    if total <= 0 then
        local idx = RandomInt(1, #list)
        return list[idx], idx
    end
    local roll = RandomFloat(0, total)
    local acc = 0
    for i, name in ipairs(list) do
        local w = tonumber(weight_fn(name)) or 0
        if w > 0 then
            acc = acc + w
            if roll <= acc then
                return name, i
            end
        end
    end
    return list[#list], #list
end

local function ParsePercentValue(value)
    if type(value) ~= "string" then
        return nil
    end
    local trimmed = string.gsub(value, "^%s*(.-)%s*$", "%1")
    local num = string.match(trimmed, "^([%-]?%d+%.?%d*)%%%s*$")
    if num then
        return tonumber(num)
    end
    return nil
end

local function ResolveEnhanceDisplayValue(raw, level)
    if raw == nil then
        return nil
    end
    if type(raw) == "table" then
        return nil
    end
    if type(raw) == "number" then
        return tostring(raw)

    local s = tostring(raw)
    if s == "" then

    end

    local tokens = ParseStringArray(s)
    if #tokens > 0 then

    end

    return s
end

local function ResolveEnhanceDisplayText(raw, level)
    local token = ResolveEnhanceDisplayValue(raw, level)
    if token == nil then
        return nil
    end
    local text = tostring(token)
    local percent = ParsePercentValue(text)
    if percent ~= nil then
        return tostring(percent / 100)
    end
    return text
end

local function ResolveEnhanceNumber(raw, level, base_value)
    if raw == nil then
        return nil
    end

    if type(raw) == "number" then
        return raw
    end

    if type(raw) == "string" then
        local token = ResolveEnhanceDisplayValue(raw, level)
        if token ~= nil then
            local percent = ParsePercentValue(token)
            if percent ~= nil then
                local base = tonumber(base_value)
                if base == nil then
                    return nil
                end
                return base * (1 + percent / 100)
            end
            local numeric = tonumber(token)
            if numeric ~= nil then
                return numeric
            end
        end
    end

    local resolved = ResolveEnhanceValue(raw, level)
    if resolved == nil then
        return nil
    end

    local percent = ParsePercentValue(resolved)
    if percent ~= nil then
        local base = tonumber(base_value)
        if base == nil then
            return nil
        end
        return base * (1 + percent / 100)
    end

    if type(resolved) == "string" then
        local numeric = tonumber(resolved)
        if numeric ~= nil then

        end
    end

    return resolved
end

local function SplitByPipe(raw)
    local list = {}
    if raw == nil then

    end
    local s = tostring(raw)

end

    if raw == nil then
        return {}

    if type(raw) == "table" then
        local list = {}
        for k, v in pairs(raw) do

    local s = tostring(raw)

    s = string.gsub(s, "%.vtex_c$", ".vtex")

    return "s2r://" .. s
end

local function GetItemFieldValue(kv, key, level)

local function CollectProjectileSlots(item_kv, level)
    local slots = {}
    if not item_kv then

    end

    local base = GetItemFieldValue(item_kv, "ProjectileName", level)

    end

        if item_kv[key] == nil and i > 2 then

            if i > 3 then
                break
            end
        end
        local val = GetItemFieldValue(item_kv, key, level)
        if val and val ~= "" and val ~= "none" then
            table.insert(slots, { name = val, context = "ProjectileSP" .. suffix })
        end
    end

    return slots
end

local function CollectItemSources(item_kv, level)
    local list = {}
    if not item_kv then
        return list
    end

    local hero = item_kv.HeroName
    for _, slot in ipairs(CollectProjectileSlots(item_kv, level)) do
        local src = ResolveSourceKey(slot.name, hero)
        if src and src ~= "" and src ~= "none" then
            table.insert(list, src)
        end
    end

    local function push(key)
        local val = GetItemFieldValue(item_kv, key, level)
        if val and val ~= "" and val ~= "none" then
            table.insert(list, val)
        end
    end

    push("PassiveName")
    push("PassiveSP")
    push("PassiveSP2")
    for i = 3, 6 do
        push("PassiveSP" .. tostring(i))

    for i, name in ipairs(targets) do

    return nil
